fields.Name: International Cheese Federation - April 2019 Archive
fields.Description: This page presents an archive of blog posts from April 2019 by the International Cheese Federation, covering topics such as the importance of food safety and HACCP certification for small creameries, the challenges faced by farmstead makers in their second year of production, and the impact of shifting international tariffs on export plans for members. It also provides general information about the federation, its mission, and links to various resources.

What a food safety plan is actually for

Industry News 

 

 

 



Yuri Lee 




 


The tariff map keeps shifting, and so should your export plan 

 

Mexico’s retaliatory tariffs came off this spring while duties into one major Asian market stayed high. We look at what that split picture means for members who ship abroad.
